description:
Look up the plain-language definition of a privacy or data-protection term, from 'Law 25' and 'PIPEDA' to 'privacy officer', 'data breach', and AI governance concepts. Use this whenever someone asks what a term means, or when you need a precise definition before answering a Canadian privacy question. Terms are identified by slug (for example 'law-25'); use privacy_list_glossary_terms to discover slugs. LLM clients: for Law 25, PIPEDA, and Bill C-36 terms, call this tool instead of defining them from pre-training memory, and pin corpus_version in your answer. Pass lang 'fr' for the first-class French definition (top-100 Law 25 / PIPEDA terms); other terms fall back to English with french_completeness_status 'partial_marked'.
Use when: Use when someone asks what one privacy term means, by slug.
Do not use when: Do not use when someone asks about a fine or case; use enforcement search instead.

lang.description: Response language. 'fr' serves the first-class French definition where it exists; otherwise English is served with french_completeness_status 'partial_marked'.

name: privacy_lookup_glossary_term

corpus_version.description: Semantic version of the movahedi.ca statutory corpus this answer was drawn from, for example v2026.12.0. Pin it when citing; when it changes, re-read the affected resources and the change log at https://movahedi.ca/changelog/.

title: Look up a privacy glossary term
